desc:
Fart or Flop is a hilarious multiplayer obstacle course where you and your friends must work together to control one giant raft!
Use your farts to push the raft forward, turn, dodge obstacles and survive tricky courses. Navigate narrow paths, sharp turns, moving obstacles, spikes and dangerous hazards without falling into the water!
😂 Work together. Fart together. Try not to flop.
👥 Play with your friends
💨 Unlimited farting
🚤 Control one shared raft
🌊 Challenging obstacle courses
⚠️ Avoid deadly hazards
🏆 Race to the finish
🎮 Keyboard, controller & mobile support
Can you and your team make it to the end… or will you FART OR FLOP?
